title: 3x3 Pickaxes
description: Craft special pickaxes that mine a 3x3 area, collect drops into your inventory, and work without custom textures.
body:
**3x3 Pickaxes** adds survival-friendly wide mining tools to Minecraft.

Craft special 3x3 versions of every vanilla pickaxe tier and mine a full 3x3 area with one block break. Drops are sent directly into your inventory, XP still drops normally, and enchantments like Fortune, Silk Touch, Unbreaking, Mending, and Efficiency work like you would expect.

The mod is designed to stay simple and server-friendly. Instead of adding custom textured items, the tools are based on vanilla pickaxes with a special green name and lore, making them easier to use on servers and crossplay setups.

## Features

- 3x3 Wooden Pickaxe
- 3x3 Stone Pickaxe
- 3x3 Iron Pickaxe
- 3x3 Golden Pickaxe
- 3x3 Diamond Pickaxe
- 3x3 Netherite Pickaxe
- Mines a 3x3 area based on the direction you mine
- Drops go directly into your inventory
- Extra drops fall normally if your inventory is full
- XP from ores still drops
- Supports Fortune and Silk Touch
- Supports normal enchanting, repairing, renaming, Unbreaking, and Mending
- No commands
- No config needed
- No custom textures or resource pack required

## Crafting

Each 3x3 pickaxe is crafted using the normal pickaxe shape, but with normal pickaxes as the ingredients.

## Important

This mod changes mining behavior, so it must be installed on the server for multiplayer.

For singleplayer testing, install it in your client mods folder and open a singleplayer world.

## Compatibility

This mod is made for Fabric and Minecraft 1.21.11.

Because it avoids custom item textures and uses vanilla pickaxe items with custom data, it is designed to be simple and server-friendly.
